provenance: Prospective supplemental engineering criteria explicitly selected in the current human implementation request; no treatment outcomes inspected
historical_policy_disposition: Preserve historical five-percentage-point plus confidence-interval policy and registrations unchanged; this is a distinct supplemental policy
atomic_aggregation: equal parent weights within each skill; equal R/S weights; paired variants stay grouped
long_context_requirement: separate genuine qualification and disjoint source-correct enrollment; a short guard or boolean alone cannot qualify it
zero_support_retention: UNDEFINED; block eligible quality claim, never treat as perfect retention
tie_preference: M1 unless an eligible M2 achieves at least 3pp macro advantage; if only one candidate is eligible select that candidate
generation_cap_correctness: All capped outputs remain in the denominator; correctness must come from the same independently registered full-visible-output verifier as uncapped outputs. This policy does not itself authorize native grading.
interval_scope: paired parent-cluster exploratory intervals within seed101; not training-draw variability or powered confirmation
